exposure: Mode of birth (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
cohort: The study included women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy for severe maternal complications in six academic maternity units in Romania.
finding: The prevalence of post-partum hysterectomy was 26/10000 deliveries in the studied centers, with primary indications being postpartum uterine atony and placental adhesion pathology.
mod_finding: The study observed that the lowest post-partum hysterectomy rate was in centers with lower cesarean section rates, suggesting an increase in cesarean deliveries may contribute to higher hysterectomy frequency.
